title: Deck Crawler: how to play
sections: Climb the map from the bottom to the boss at the top and defeat it. If your health reaches 0 the run is over and you start again with a fresh deck.

Tap a lit room on the next floor to go there; drag to scroll the map. Sword rooms are battles, the chest is treasure (a free relic), the heart is a campfire (rest to heal 30% of your health), the coin is a shop (buy cards and relics with gold) and the white diamond is an event. The boss waits at the top.

Each turn you get 3 mana and draw a new hand (Warrior 4 cards, Assassin 5, Wizard 3). The number in a card's top corner is its mana cost. Drag a card up onto the battlefield to play it; attacks that hit one enemy show an arrow, so drop them on the enemy you want. Drag a card back down to cancel. Tap End Turn when you're done: your unused cards go to the discard pile.

Block (the shield) absorbs damage until your next turn, then it's gone. Above each enemy you see its intent: what it will do on its turn, for example a sword with the damage it will deal. Block enough to survive big attacks, attack when they're defending.
Some cards put statuses on you or on enemies, shown as small icons. Exposed: takes 50% more damage for a few turns. Muscle: attacks deal extra damage. Tap a status icon to read what it does.

Winning a battle gives gold and a choice of new cards for your deck (you may also skip). Relics give lasting bonuses for the whole run; tap a relic at the top to read it. Your card piles (bottom corners) can be tapped to look at them.
A smaller deck draws your best cards more often, so you don't have to take every card. Rest at campfires when your health is low. The run saves as you go: Continue on the main menu picks it up.
